versions.content: Handling if EthTrcv_MacSecResetRxSc is called and EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecResetRxSc is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthTrcvMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthTrcvConfig identified with the given TrcvIdx • a receive secure channel with the given RxSci exists at this PHY then the EthTrcv driver shall reset the receive secure channel given with RxSci at the PHY that corresponds to the given TrcvIdx to default values and return with E_OK . Otherwise the EthTrcv driver shall return with E_NOT_OK .
